# Latent Courses

Four bundled, browser-native reference courses for learning how language-model
systems work, from mathematical and machine-learning foundations through agent
harnesses and a complete local chat application.

Course catalog:
/course

Courses:
/courses/linear-algebra
/courses/machine-learning-basics
/courses/harness-engineering
/courses/llm-systems

Study tools:
/practice
/flashcards
/sources

The exercises run in reviewed browser runtimes. Learner code, progress,
checkpoints, and flash-card ratings stay on the learner's device. No hosted
model API or API key is required.

Latent Courses is built with the Latent open-source learning-platform
framework. Courses a publisher creates through Open Learning are portable
Learning Packs hosted at publisher-controlled URLs; they are not added to this
bundled learner catalog. Publishing tools and public portable-content contracts
belong to the framework product.
